move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You kept the quote brief and headed back to the machines—it sounds like you value a straightforward discussion that leaves time for production. We want an efficient agreement grounded in the cost basis for this part. How could flexibility on payment timing and delivery help you sharpen the price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0). Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:SH-220). Our demand forecast for this part is on record (fc:SH-220@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Further, we checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our current offer is a price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net, and our Lieferzeit is 42 days. We have free capacity for your parts. The 42 days lead time and DAP delivery are fine, that gives us some breathing room in the shop. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. 

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. As an alternative, with a price of €15.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP: if you agree to 14 days payment, we can drop the price to 15.20 per piece.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that volume change data into account. We have already taken that should cost data into account. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €16.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We appreciate the confirmed volume of 6,000 units per year, which allows us to reduce our price to €15.50 per unit. To answer your question, a 35-day lead time requires costly production adjustments, so we have adjusted the lead time to 45 days to offer this price reduction; however, faster payment terms would enable further flexibility. 

Alternatively, at our standard terms, we offer a price of €15.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 45 days: €15.50 per unit. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
